units: G = c = M = 1: lengths in GM/c^2, times in GM/c^3, angles in radians, u = 1/r

conventions.b: impact parameter L/E (>= 0); d = b/b_c - 1 is the near-critical variable (b = b_c (1 + d) exactly)
conventions.theta: look angle in the named observer frame between the look direction (towards where the light comes from) and the direction of the hole (inward radial)
conventions.dphi: azimuth swept by the backward-traced ray (from the observer) in its orbital plane, measured from the observer's radius vector towards the look direction
conventions.escape direction: n_inf = cos(dphi) rhat + sin(dphi) e, rhat the observer's outward radial unit vector, e the unit part of the look direction perpendicular to rhat
conventions.ln_g / ln_f: ln(nu_observed / nu_emitted_at_infinity) for light from the distant sky (static: -1/2 ln(1 - 2/r); raindrop: -ln(1 - v cos theta); plus ln D of the ship when moving)
conventions.lens Phi: angle at the hole between the observer's and the source's position vectors, 0..pi
conventions.lens side: +1: the image on the source's side of the observer-hole axis, dphi = Phi + 2 pi k; -1: the opposite side, dphi = 2 pi - Phi + 2 pi k
conventions.lens mu: signed magnification = d_E^2 dOmega_o/dA_s, d_E^2 = ro^2 + rs^2 - 2 ro rs cos Phi; sign = parity. Flux of an image: F = L/(4 pi) g^4 dOmega_dA with g = sqrt((1 - 2/rs)/(1 - 2/ro))
conventions.lens t: coordinate time from emission at the source to reception (units of M); differences between images are the time delays (full set only)
conventions.mu_inf (static map): magnification of a point source at infinity: -sin(theta)/(sin(dphi) d dphi/d theta)
conventions.foot: order-0 images (k = 0, side +1) of sources nearer the hole than the camera, gamma (= Phi) around the flat foot acos(rs/ro)
conventions.forward_caustic: order-1 images (k = 0, side -1: dphi = 2 pi - gamma) of sources gamma from the axis behind the camera; rs "inf" is the sky
conventions.drip: radial fall from rest at r0: r = r0 cos^2(eta/2), tau = sqrt(r0^3/8)(eta + sin eta); T the Painleve-Gullstrand time since the start by quadrature of dT/dtau = (e^2 + x)/(e + sqrt(x) sqrt(2/r0) tan(eta/2)), x = 2/r; dB: closed form (Schwarzschild t plus the PG offset, outside the horizon) minus quadrature
conventions.inputs: every input is the IEEE double written here (except rows with input "d", where b = b_c (1 + d) exactly); outputs are the exact results for those inputs rounded to double; *_25 fields give 25 digits
conventions.dB fields: method B (numerical integration of the geodesic equations, 30-50 digits) minus method A (closed forms)

strong.form: alpha = -ln d + bbar + sum_j d^j (c_j ln d + e_j), d = b/b_c - 1, L = bbar + pi = 3 ln 6 - 2 ln(2 + sqrt3)

time.units: M = 1: times in GM/c^3 (Sgr A*: 21.165 s)
